title: 8♠ Free Scuttle respects Scuttle immunity
purpose: Separate rank/suit bypass from Scuttle immunity.

title: Explicit control change immediately severs Jack
purpose: Preserve explicit new controller while scrapping invalid Attachment.

title: PR Jack creates an authoritative Attachment graph
purpose: Create graph, change control, and derive the +1 Jack bonus.

title: Jack removal immediately restores its host
purpose: A severed Jack goes to GY and the host returns to its original owner row.

title: Guard blocks hostile single-target Effects
purpose: Guard protects another friendly OTT card, not Actions.

title: Guard does not protect against Scuttle
purpose: Scuttle is an Action and ignores Guard while respecting its own checks.

title: Aegis blocks friendly Effects
purpose: Aegis is not enemy-only and remains separate from Guard.

title: Rank effect-target immunity is independent
purpose: A PR Four rejects an ordinary targeted Effect without gaining Aegis.

title: Q♠ survives non-total multi-target clears
purpose: Q♠ protection is a named clear immunity, not Aegis.

title: Structural total clear uses only named bypasses
purpose: 4♠-class structural bypass clears Aegis and Q♠ protection.

title: 8♠ Free Scuttle ignores rank and suit
purpose: Free Scuttle can remove a higher-rank target that lacks immunity and Aegis.

title: ⭐8 bypasses ordinary Scuttle immunity
purpose: Absolute Scuttle names immunity bypass but not Aegis bypass.

title: ⭐8 remains blocked by Aegis
purpose: Bypassing Scuttle immunity does not imply bypassing Aegis.

title: Royal Shield blocks only Base and Anchor Ace
purpose: A failed Base Ace leaves state unchanged; A♠ then counters the protected play.

title: King and K♠ counter authority remain distinct
purpose: Regular King rejects a multi-play; K♠ counters it.
